_what: take.py's beat door (take_beats.py): beats carried as fields (who, action, prop, target, where) before anything is bought; the made take read against every beat, its cast and its line-up, a take that misses one never used.
_fields: false: a beat with no who or no action no longer stops a paid take (the gaps are still listed in sent.json).
_take: false: the made take is placed without being read against its beats.
_rollback: "on": false turns both off; TAKE_BEATS_OFF=1 or =fields / =take on one machine. Row TAKE-BEATS in team/rollbacks.md.
